title: Probe reports a post-reap pipe-drain timeout as a retryable child timeout
outcome: A bounded-read pipe-drain timeout that occurs after the child was reaped is attributed distinctly from a child deadline timeout. It covers a surviving descendant holding the pipe open, or a stuck reader. The federation probe does not tell the caller "timed out; retry the check" for it, unless a coordinator records why retry is the right advice there.
acceptance: Probe reports a post-reap pipe-drain timeout as a retryable child timeout is done
